actual_gain.docs:
The value of gain used for reported values. Particularly useful when "auto_mode" is selected.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

actual_integration_time.docs:
Integration time used for reported values, ms. Particularly useful when "auto_mode" is selected.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

ambient_light.docs:
Illuminance for visible light (_ALS channel_), lx.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

ambient_light_counts.docs:
The reading for visible light (_ALS channel_), counts.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

auto_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Automatic gain and integration time selection. Defaults to `True`.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

full_spectrum.docs:
Illuminance for the full spectrum sensor (_WHITE channel_), lx.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

full_spectrum_counts.docs:
The reading for the full spectrum sensor (_WHITE channel_), counts.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

gain.docs:
**string**: The gain the device will use for the internal ADC. Valid values are `1/8x` _(default)_, `1/4x`, `1x`, `2x`. Higher values are better in low-light conditions. _In automatic mode it sets starting gain value_.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

glass_attenuation_factor.docs:
The attenuation factor of glass if it's behind some glass or plastic facia. Default is `1.0` means `100%` transmissivity. `2` means `50%` transmissivity etc.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

infrared.docs:
Calculated illuminance for the Near-IR spectrum (_WHITE_ minus _ALS_), lx.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

integration_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The amount of time the sensor is exposed. Valid values are `25ms`, `50ms`, `100ms` _(default)_, `200ms`, `400ms`, `800ms`. _In automatic mode it sets starting value_.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

lux_compensation.docs:
**boolean**: Lux compensation formula is used as per manufacturer. Defaults to `True`.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval for checking the sensors. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [VEML7700 and VEML6030 Ambient Light Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/veml7700#configuration-variables)*
